summary: ⊆ by inclHFin_mem_besselH; ⊇: conjugate back to the standard basis and use that every element of 𝖧 comes from U(X₀).

steps.claim: The image lies in 𝖧 (inclHFin_mem_besselH). Conversely, for h ∈ 𝖧 in the lattice basis, BhB⁻¹ lies in 𝖧 of the standard form (a product of elements of 𝖧, the conjugation by the lattice basis preserving 𝖧), so it is toBesselH of some element of U(X₀)(𝔸_f) (exists_toBesselH_eq, N being a unit because π̄π = N); applying toLatBasis gives h = inclHFin(that element).
steps.lean:
lemma range_inclHFin : S.inclHFin.range = besselH := le_antisymm (fun _ ⟨k, e⟩ ↦
  e ▸ inclHFin_mem_besselH k) fun _ h ↦ .imp (fun _ ↦ S.toLatBasis.eq_symm_apply.1 ∘ .symm)
  (exists_toBesselH_eq (by apply mul_mem (mul_mem _ h.out) <;> aesop) (by simp [← piBar_mul_star]))
